create_evaluation_tokenizer: create an EvaluationTokenizer with sacreBLEU tokenizer type 13a for BLEU evaluation
tokenize_sentence: tokenize a sentence using the EvaluationTokenizer with optional lowercasing and punctuation removal
remove_punctuation: remove punctuation tokens from a sentence based on Unicode category using remove_punctuation
create_character_tokenizer: create an EvaluationTokenizer with character tokenization enabled for character-level evaluation
review_tokenizer_types: review the available sacreBLEU tokenizer types supported by EvaluationTokenizer ALL_TOKENIZER_TYPES
